ValidationRule.description: A Cancellation Reason is required to cancel a meeting.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( CancellationReason ), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Meeting Canceled by Student" ) || ISPICKVAL( Status, "Canceled" ) || ISPICKVAL( Status, "Meeting Canceled by Educational Strategist" ) || ISPICKVAL( Status, "Meeting Canceled by Parent" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide a Cancellation Reason before marking the meeting as canceled.
